commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: The cistern drains below the storage pit. If we empty it, the boards may still be there.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: Paper will not survive that water.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Then we save the wood it was nailed to.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: Three handles. The middle one opens both channels if you turn it first.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: Left, right, middle. I have marked them.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: And if the marks wash away?

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I stay here and call the order.
